name: Losvius Longnose
description: Lightfoot halfling teamster with an overpowering curiosity about other people’s embarrassing secrets.
reuseWhen: Use the supplied card for visual continuity when staging the character.

assets.description: Supplied portrait card for Losvius Longnose.
Losvius makes room while Coppercoil climbs the threshold.
Losvius, Coppercoil and Aldrik confer quietly about the wager inside the porcelain wagon.

appearance.features: Curly brown hair, prominent ears and an amused expression.
appearance.clothing: Cream rolled-sleeve shirt, dark green vest, red neckerchief, patched trousers and buckled brown boots.
appearance.equipment: Driving whip, coiled rope, leather satchel and a brass bell.

events.location: Road from Baldur’s Gate to Waterdeep
events.event: Reported the crate in Lasfelro’s wagon and accepted a wager to investigate a cult wagon during the next substantial fight.

events.location: Road from Baldur’s Gate to Waterdeep
events.event: Slipped into Lasfelro’s wagon during Carlon’s rescue and found a seven-foot wooden crate surrounded by dark soil.

events.location: Road from Baldur’s Gate to Waterdeep
events.event: Invited Coppercoil into his porcelain-filled wagon during the rain. Aldrik used a spectral hand to save some of the porcelain as Coppercoil climbed in.
